# Keep renamed release scripts aligned in commands and source URLs

Entry 526 updates MANIFEST_URL to repack.sh after the script rename. Current worker command and URL both name repack.sh. A renamed file must update the remote script lookup as well as the local worker command. No release job or network fetch was run; this does not establish the current remote host file endpoint is functional.

Scope: taskcluster/kinds/release-flatpak-repackage.
